title: Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Recommender Systems (MMRS) leverage rich item features to mitigate data sparsity, yet similarity-driven graph construction and propagation can favor semantically similar substitutes over functionally related complements. When behavioral associations connect semantically distant items, complementary signals can remain geometrically isolated, yielding fragmented "Similarity Islands" and semantic drift when standard propagation is applied. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAGE (Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding), a framework for personalized multimodal ranking that decouples complementarity modeling into offline geometric warping and online topological propagation. translated_title: 互补信号能否桥接相似性孤岛？面向多模态推荐的流形增强图嵌入
translated_abstract: 多模态推荐系统（MMRS）利用丰富的物品特征来缓解数据稀疏问题，然而基于相似性驱动的图构建与传播往往更偏向语义相似的替代品，而非功能上相关的互补品。当行为关联将语义上相距较远的物品连接起来时，互补信号可能在几何上保持孤立，形成碎片化的“相似性孤岛”，并且在应用标准传播时产生语义漂移。为克服这些局限，我们提出了MAGE（流形增强图嵌入），这是一个用于个性化多模态排序的框架，它将互补性建模解耦为离线几何扭曲和在线拓扑传播两个阶段。离线阶段通过Soft Conceptor机制提取互补感知的残差方向，并在保持局部间隙的约束下将其注入物品表示中，在纳入共同购买证据的同时控制（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MAGE框架，将互补性建模解耦为离线几何扭曲和在线拓扑传播，利用Soft Conceptor机制提取互补感知的残差方向并注入物品表示，从而桥接多模态推荐中语义孤立物品形成的“相似性孤岛”。
en_tdlr: MAGE is proposed as a manifold-augmented graph embedding framework that decouples complementarity modeling into offline geometric warping and online topological propagation, using a Soft Conceptor mechanism to inject complement-aware residual directions into item representations and bridge the "Similarity Islands" formed by semantically isolated items in multimodal recommendation.
